parameters.name: TaskList
parameters.description:
The site monitoring tasks.

>  You must create at least one site monitoring task. You must specify all of the `Address`, `TaskName`, and `TaskType` parameters in each request.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cms batch-create-instant-site-monitor --task-list Address=https://www.aliyun.com OptionsJson=time_out_:5000 TaskName=HangZhou_ECS1 TaskType=HTTP IspCities=city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465 --api-version 2019-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cms BatchCreateInstantSiteMonitor --region cn-hangzhou --TaskList.1.Address 'https://www.aliyun.com' --TaskList.1.TaskType HTTP --TaskList.1.OptionsJson 'time_out_:5000' --TaskList.1.TaskName HangZhou_ECS1 --TaskList.1.IspCities 'city_:_546_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_572_,_isp_:_465_,_city_:_738_,_isp_:_465'
